senses.gloss: ch. to strangle. Targ. II Esth. I, 3.—
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 60b:10">Keth. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>וחֲנַקְתֵּיה</he> she choked her child to death; <he>דלא … דחַנְקַן בנייהו</he> for women (of sound mind) will not choke their children (in order to be allowed to marry again before the lapse of a certain time).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:19">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> top … <he>הוה והוה ח׳ ליה</he> air burst forth out of the bottle and choked him.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:5">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ</cite> <he>חַנְקַת גרמה</he> she hanged herself.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:12">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top <he>בעייא … מִיחְנְקוּנֵיה</he> I would rather choke him; a. e.—
Targ. II Sam. XVII, 23.—Y. Snh. X, 29ᵃ bot. כדון דוד מִתְחַנֵּק now David will die in despair (cmp. preced. Nif.).
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>יהא סופיה מִתְחַנְּקָא</he> will end his life by suicide.
